answer:
According to your records, you are currently on two medications:

1. Jardiance (empagliflozin) 10 mg tablet, for your type 2 diabetes. It was prescribed on 20 February 2025 and is listed as active. It lowers blood sugar by making the kidneys pass extra sugar in the urine, and it also protects the heart and kidneys.

2. Atorvastatin 20 mg tablet, a statin to lower cholesterol. It was also prescribed on 20 February 2025 and is listed as active.

You used to take metformin 500 mg for diabetes, from March 2022 until it was stopped on 15 April 2024, so it is no longer on your list.

A few things to keep in mind: the records show when these were prescribed, not that you are actually taking them every day, and they come from one hospital, so anything prescribed elsewhere, or anything you buy over the counter (vitamins, supplements, pain relievers), would not appear. It is worth bringing your actual pill bottles or a list to your check-up so it can be confirmed.
